conflicts.permit: Learn more – how Google uses data from partners’ sites or apps: http://www.google.com/policies/privacy/partners/
conflicts.prohibit: We will not share your current location with partners.
conflicts.situation: Sharing precise location or automatically collected data with Google or other partners via Google Firebase or Google Analytics tools integrated into the service.
conflicts.reason: The policy broadly promises not to share current location with partners, yet refers users to partner data usage policies for integrated third-party SDKs without clarifying exceptions.
